title: Dialing for Data: Inside the Com’s High-Profile Heists
description: Unit 42 has analyzed a series of vishing attacks and extortion campaigns by Com-affiliated threat actors targeting data-rich sectors such as healthcare, finance, and legal services primarily in the U.S., UK, and Australia. These attacks involve social engineering to gain initial access, use of adversary-in-the-middle proxies to capture credentials and MFA approvals, automated data exfiltration from Microsoft 365 environments, and extortion via internal messaging directing victims to Tor-hosted negotiation sites. A malicious browser extension masquerading as Google Chrome was also identified, capable of keylogging, stealing authentication cookies, capturing webcam feeds, and remote control via Chrome DevTools Protocol. Multiple named threat clusters and actors are involved, with some newly identified in late 2026. The activity is ongoing with detailed telemetry and incident response engagements informing the analysis.
